settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.subtitle: Manage your account and preferences.
settingsPage.displayNameHandleHint: Used to build your Whisper Box link, so friends can recognize it.
settingsPage.handleDescriptionAssigned: Your persistent, public handle across Debate Now.
settingsPage.handleDescriptionUnassigned: Created automatically the first time you post or comment as a Whisperer.
settingsPage.twoFactorEnabled: Enabled — your account requires a second step at sign-in.
settingsPage.twoFactorNotSetUp: Not set up — your account only requires a password to sign in.
settingsPage.pushNotificationsDescription: Get notified the moment a whisp is opened, watched, or replied to.
settingsPage.emailNotificationsDescription: Get an email when someone whisps you. You'll always see it in the app either way — this only controls the extra email.
settingsPage.showOnlineStatusDescription: Let accounts that follow you in Debate Now see when you're online. Turning this off also hides everyone else's online status from you.
settingsPage.appBadge: Badge app icon with unread count
settingsPage.appBadgeDescription: When installed to your home screen, show your total unread count as a badge on the app icon. Not a live widget — just a number on the icon.
settingsPage.toastShowOnlineStatusOn: Your online status is now visible to your followers
settingsPage.toastShowOnlineStatusOff: Your online status is now hidden
settingsPage.adminNewSignupDescription: Get notified when someone new joins the app.
settingsPage.adminNewDebateTopicDescription: Get notified when someone posts a new debate topic.
settingsPage.toastAdminNewSignupOn: You'll be notified about new signups
settingsPage.toastAdminNewDebateTopicOn: You'll be notified about new Debate Now posts
settingsPage.privacyWhispsText: All whisps are sent anonymously by default. Recipient contact information (email/phone) is used solely for delivery and is never shared with third parties.
settingsPage.privacyGhostBoostText: Ghost Boost doesn't collect recipient contact info — it's a queued, boosted-reach send with no specific recipient, not a targeted ad.
settingsPage.privacyDataRequestText: You can request a full data export or account deletion by contacting support.

accountSecurityPage.title: Account security
accountSecurityPage.subtitle: Manage two-factor authentication and other security settings for your account.

creditsPage.toastCheckoutUnavailable: Checkout is not available right now
creditsPage.toastBillingNotSetUpDescription: Ask an admin to configure Stripe to enable payments.
creditsPage.title: Credits & Plan
creditsPage.subtitle: Manage your subscription and Ghost Boost credits.

subscribePage.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Double check your email and try again.
subscribePage.successDescriptionVerified: Your topics are updated. Anonymous whisps matching them may land in your inbox anytime.
subscribePage.successDescriptionPending: Click the confirmation link we just emailed you to start receiving matches. It's the only way we know a real person owns this address.
subscribePage.heading: Get matched with anonymous whisps
subscribePage.description: Strangers on Blind Whisper send videos anonymously to people who might need them. Pick a few topics and we'll occasionally send you one that matches — no account needed, unsubscribe anytime.
subscribePage.topicsLabel: Topics you'd want to hear about ({{count}}/{{max}})
subscribePage.footerNote: We'll only ever email you a whisp that matches your topics, or a one-click unsubscribe link. No spam, no selling your email.

verifySubscriptionPage.linkNotValidDescription: This confirmation link looks broken or expired. Head back to the subscribe page to sign up again.
verifySubscriptionPage.confirmedDescription: You'll start getting anonymous whisps that match your topics. You can unsubscribe anytime from the link in any email we send.

unsubscribePage.linkNotValidDescription: This unsubscribe link looks broken or expired.
unsubscribePage.unsubscribedDescription: You won't get any more matched whisps. You can resubscribe anytime from the subscribe page.

invitePage.title: Invite a Friend
invitePage.subtitle: Invite someone to join Blind Whisper — anonymously, exactly like a whisp. They won't know it's from you unless you choose to reveal yourself later.
invitePage.noInvitesYet: You haven't sent any invites yet.
invitePage.revealAccepted: They accepted! You can now reveal your identity.
invitePage.smsDisclosure: By sending to a phone number, you're texting them on your own behalf. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. See our
invitePage.smsConsentCheckbox: I confirm I have this person's permission to receive a text from me via Blind Whisper.
invitePage.smsConsentOneTime: You only need to confirm this once for each new contact.

publicInvitePage.notFound: This invite could not be found.
publicInvitePage.leadText: Someone who cares about you is inviting you to install Blind Whisper — for honest conversations without the awkwardness, kept confidential and anonymous.
publicInvitePage.stayAnonymousDescription: Blind Whisper is for sending videos and honest notes to people who need them — without them knowing it's you, unless you choose to say so.
publicInvitePage.revealAccepted: You've let them know it's okay to reveal themselves.
publicInvitePage.revealDeclined: You've chosen to keep this anonymous.
publicInvitePage.revealRequestHeading: Someone who invited you wants to reveal themselves.
publicInvitePage.revealRequestQuestion: Do you want to know who invited you?
publicInvitePage.poweredBySuffix: — send what matters, without the awkward part.
